title: Compliance Beacon: Automated Tenant Residency Snapshots for Dedicated Pools
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Enterprise customers running Redwood Dedicated require periodic, verifiable evidence that tenant compute and data were confined to declared regions and isolated from other tenants. Current ad-hoc manual exports cause delays for audits and are error-prone.

Goal: Implement a lightweight, automated "compliance beacon" that emits signed residency snapshots for each dedicated tenant pool on a configurable cadence. Each snapshot ("snapshot envelope") will include: pool identifier, active node list with zone metadata, verified region mapping, retention policy applied, and cryptographic metadata (signature, KMS key ID, hash). Snapshots are stored immutably, discoverable via an audit index, and exportable as a tamper-evident bundle for customer audits and SOC reviews.

Scope: MVP focuses on dedicated GPU pools (Dedicated V1) and tenant isolation evidence only (no full data flow proofs). The beacon will integrate with existing telemetry (node registration), KMS for signing, S3-compatible archival, and the console's compliance export UI. This ticket covers backend snapshot generation, signing pipeline, indexer, retention enforcement hooks, and a minimal console endpoint to download a snapshot bundle.

Non-goals: live packet-level tracing, deterministic hardware attestation (TPM), and on-prem private control plane packaging (future work).

Key design trade-offs:
- Frequency vs cost: default hourly cadence with configurable downto-daily to balance storage and customer requirements.
- Signed minimalism: include only metadata required for isolation claims to avoid PII exposure.
- Mutability: snapshots are write-once and deleted only by retention policy; we will not support edit-in-place to preserve evidentiary guarantees.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot generator produces per-tenant envelopes on the configured cadence with schema v1
Each envelope is signed using the org KMS key and contains a SHA-256 manifest hash
Snapshots are archived to S3 with object immutability flag (or equivalent) and listed in the audit index
Console API returns a downloadable, zipped bundle with snapshot JSON and signature for a requested tenant and time range
Retention TTLs are enforced: objects older than tenant-configured retention are queued for secure deletion and recorded in a retention log
E2E tests validate that changing a node's region metadata will be reflected in the next snapshot and recorded as a delta in the audit index
tasks: Define snapshot envelope schema (fields, minimal metadata, redaction rules)
Implement snapshot producer service that subscribes to node registry and pool state stream
Integrate KMS signing flow and generate signature metadata
Archive snapshots to compliance bucket with immutability controls and lifecycle rules
Build audit index service to surface per-tenant snapshot history and deltas
Expose console API and S3-presigned download flow for bundles
Add retention enforcement worker and retention audit log
Create E2E test harness and synthetic tenant to validate snapshots and retention
Author runbook for incident handling and evidence re-issuance
comments: 2026-01-16 Miguel: Spike complete. Prototype signs sample envelope using KMS and uploads to compliance-sandbox. See PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/1298

2026-01-22 Asha: Design review feedback - minimize included IP addresses to avoid PII leakage; prefer region codes + node stable IDs. Updated schema draft uploaded: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RES/Compliance+Beacon+Schema
2026-01-25 Design (Lina): Console UX sketch ready; will add a 'Download evidence bundle' action in tenant settings. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/Beacon-UX

2026-01-29 QA: Found race where node registry updates could miss a snapshot window under high churn. Mitigation: snapshot producer will read last-known state from the registry at generation time and also consume the stream for deltas. Added extra task to tasks list.
2026-02-02 Security (Raj): Approved signing model but requested KMS key rotation and proof-of-rotation records be included in bundle. Added as TODO for follow-up spike.
mitigation_risks: Large fleets may generate a high volume of snapshots; cost can be controlled via configurable cadence per-tenant
Accidental inclusion of PII requires strict schema redaction rules before signing
KMS key compromise would invalidate prior signatures; mitigated by key rotation proofs and cross-signed backup keys
Retention deletion needs an auditable workflow to avoid accidental evidence loss; retention log will record all deletions and operator approvals
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): Generate snapshots for internal test-tenants in us-west-2, run E2E validation for 2 weeks
Phase 2 (pilot): Enable on 3 existing dedicated customers with signed consent; collect feedback and storage metrics
Phase 3 (general): Make feature self-serve for all Dedicated customers with default hourly cadence and console opt-in for archive exports
Rollback: disable snapshot producer and revoke presigned URLs. Retention-deleted objects are irrecoverable; rollback policy emphasizes safe disablement only
telemetry_signal_defs: beacon.snapshot.generated: counter with tenant_id, pool_id, success/failure
beacon.snapshot.latency_ms: histogram measuring time to generate and sign snapshot
beacon.archive.upload_latency_ms: histogram for S3 upload and immutability enforcement
beacon.audit.index_updates: counter to surface indexing failures
